name: House
notes: One-storey rural house (2026-11-27). Blocks sight and movement. Protects whoever stands behind it. One defender can stand inside it (house_inside cover). Values are a proposal.

name: House (inside)
notes: Cover of the one defender inside a house, from every side. Not placed on a map. Values are a proposal.

name: Ruined house
notes: A house without a roof: infantry climbs through slowly, vehicles cannot pass. Values are a proposal.

name: Fence
notes: A wooden fence: hides what is behind it but gives no protection. Values are a proposal.

name: Sunflower field
notes: Tall sunflowers (2026-11-27): hide who is inside and beyond, but give no cover against fire. Values are a proposal.

name: Burned forest belt
notes: A burned belt (2026-11-27): looks like a belt, hides almost nothing and gives no cover. Values are a proposal.

name: Hay stack
notes: Hay or straw stack (2026-11-28, map sheets #51). Like a spoil heap: cover behind it. Burning when hit is not in the Sim yet. Values are a proposal.

name: Field shed
notes: Field shed (2026-11-28, map sheets #51). Like a small house, but no defender can stand inside. Values are a proposal.

name: Silo or tower
notes: Silo, water tower or windmill (2026-11-28, map sheets #51). Like a rock; a landmark. A spotter on top is not in the Sim yet. Values are a proposal.

name: Camouflage net
notes: Camouflage net (2026-11-28, map sheets #51). Hides who is under it and beyond, but gives no cover against fire. Player building is for later. Values are a proposal.

name: Dugout
notes: Dugout (2026-11-28, map sheets #51): a trench with a roof. Stronger cover than a trench against indirect fire and aviation. Values are a proposal.
